name: bizly
description: SaaS de gestion et d'analyse pour petites entreprises

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bizly/shared && concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bizly/shared && npm run build -w @bizly/server && npm run build -w @bizly/web && npm run build -w @bizly/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bizly/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bizly/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
